description: Composite raw-scan -> datum transform (row-major 4x4). Applies to 1_scan_raw_STL / 2_mesh_cleaned/OOM-P03.stl and OOM-P03_work_250k.stl (same RAW scanner coords). Datum: rotation/hex axis -> +Z (toward DRIVE/hex side); PAD-attach velcro field plane -> Z=0; origin on rotation axis (least-squares rim-circle center). No scale applied (caliper ENV-D1 127.54 vs scan rim 127.84, ratio 0.998, single-axis check per RE_SPEC 2).
axis_source: PCA flat-face normal (126k verts) for direction; least-squares Kasa circle fit on solid rim outer edge for XY center (resSD 0.039mm); Z origin at pad velcro field (median).
notes: F08 tread OD ~140 (intake scan guess) REJECTED as raw-frame tilt artifact; true OD tips Ø128.6 (raw+work meshes both cap at r=64.32).
refinement: matrix_4x4 refined by best-fit ICP (Kabsch, 90%-trimmed) of scan outer skin to CAD (rot 0.405 deg, trans 0.093 mm) to match verifier ICP frame.
